observed_runtime_sample.context: Earlier idle post-deployment single observation before the mobile follow-up; not peak use or a quota

limits: Physical iPhone orientation/gestures and actual Cast/AirPlay receivers require device verification.
Actual 4K HEVC/HDR video support depends on the viewing device; software fallback is explicit and can use battery.
Live OpenSubtitles search requires a configured API key/account; provider contract was tested with a mock.
Audio alignment is bounded and best-effort; dubs/edits can require manual offsets and speed adjustment.
Cached PNG/subtitle data still occupies database disk space; budgets are not zero-resource promises.

Online playback currently resolves compatible MovieBox MP4 sources; availability and CDN uptime vary. A transient upstream timeout was reproduced and returns a recoverable 502. Signed iframe-only sites are not embedded as substitutes for the custom player.

Torrent preview testing uses a real local seed connected by a disposable-only hook; public swarm availability varies. Preview budget is bounded, not zero-resource. v2-only downloads remain unsupported by the existing permanent download wrapper.
Phone checks use browser viewports; they do not prove physical iPhone orientation, hardware decoding or receiver behavior.
